content:
marisol: Quick sync on billing drift postmortem. We saw token overcounts for two windows last quarter. Need owners and next steps.

lina: I can own the invoice corrections and audit trail.

kevin: Eng will take the ingest race fix. Hotfix today, full rollout next week.

samir: I'll add a drift metric and an alert (threshold 0.5% over 1h).

maggie: I'll draft customer comms and credit tiers. Legal-bot, please confirm any wording constraints.

legal-bot: Legal: auto-credit policy ok for deltas >1%. Manual review required 0.5%-1%.

marisol: Owners: lina (corrections), kevin (ingest), samir (monitoring), maggie (comms). Timeline: hotfix today, canary reprocess Fri, full backfill Tue. Confirm?

lina: Confirmed. I'll post a 10-account sample before canary.

kevin: Confirmed. I'll run a staging dry-run and post PR link.

samir: Confirmed. Alerting and dashboard ETA EOD.

maggie: Confirmed. I'll sync with CS on outreach cadence.

marisol: I'll create tickets and tag owners. Thanks team — we'll reconvene after the staging dry-run.
